milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate to the sandstone building and look at the potted_dead_bush block placed at spawn-relative coordinates (5, 1, 7). The max_distance of 5 ensures the player has entered or is at the entrance of the building, and facing_tolerance of 60 degrees ensures they are actually looking toward the potted dead bush rather than just passing by. This correctly models 'player can see the target object'.
